title: Field-neutral class-unit result envelope
objective: Define and verify a canonical immutable field-neutral class-and-unit correspondence result without self-granting mathematical authority

oracles: Existing H1 mathematical cold replay and independently supplied authority digest

handoff.summary: Added a versioned canonical field-neutral class-and-unit correspondence envelope, immutable detached verification, externally rooted mathematical replay authority, authenticated owner lengths/capacities, exact-units and PRECI/LARGE tagged outcomes, honesty/assumption/terminal tiers, atomic publication, and adversarial mutation coverage.
risks: The existing H1 cold replay remains Python in-process, so no H1 adapter is published until a trusted cross-runtime replay receipt or source-transparent replay port exists.

pnpm test:changed reached and passed merge/build/architecture gates but its broad origin/main-derived unit suite then failed because this no-install worktree lacks the optional sagejs_flint.node addon.
next_steps: Expose a data-only independently authenticated H1 replay receipt, then map the replayed H1 logical owners into this envelope without granting authority from the envelope itself.
Generalize field-specific replay providers for nontrivial class groups and unit not_given outcomes while retaining public_complete=false.
